datasets.price_definition: Official TJEA daily total published two-decimal transaction mean, CNY/tonne; not close
datasets.source_processing: All1077 official canonical daily-total records retained; price preserved without recomputing turnover/volume; no model-based cleaning
datasets.source_vintage: Current public historical snapshot; per-day publication vintages unverified. Stage d already scored this tail; fully exposed development in stage e.
datasets.license: No redistribution license established; canonical rows remain private

datasets.price_definition: Published daily TOTAL transaction mean in yuan per tonne, retained exactly as reported; not closing price or listing-only mean
datasets.source_processing: Take every row from main CEA table index4; sort dates ascending and strip numeric thousands separators only. No row deletion, no deduplication, no date fill, no price recomputation, no splice.
datasets.source_vintage: Current public historical snapshot; daily publication vintages unverified. Raw source values were previously read/QC; repository evidence found no prior CEA forecast scoring. Confirmation is limited to this fixed stage-e scoring design.
datasets.license: No explicit redistribution license identified; raw and per-date CSV remain local-only. Public source/QC metadata and reconstruction script.

selection: training-only profiled weighted ridge plus nonlinear Adam; validation selects alpha/lr/epoch; ties use alpha then lr then epoch
refit: fresh initialization; all H20-mature pretest labels; exactly selected nonlinear epoch count; recompute training head scales and ridge beta each update
epoch0: fitted signed linear readout on fixed initial rates, not a completely untrained fixed prediction
past_information: 64 historical price changes and current activity/volume context; volume reference prior60 target records; no energy or future context
global_normalization: fixed initial-train price RMS and H-specific training target second moments throughout selection/refit/test
dynamic_interpretation: origin-conditioned discriminative forecast, frozen future rates within each issued horizon; no generative or rolling tower-property claim
initialization_diagnostic: same chosen alpha and initial nonlinear rates/gates, readout exactly refitted on final training labels; saved without selection or extra p-values
linear_solve_count_definition: Every response epoch including epoch0 solves one readout;8 ridge_interaction selection+1 refit,8 ridge_price selection+1 refit,plus6 fixed-dynamics diagnostic solves. Report actual readout solves separately from nonlinear optimizer steps.

runtime.precision: float64 for all new response calculations; frozen legacy model float32
